content.uri: data:image/jpeg;base64,<camera image removed: physical NAO in a shared lab>

part.text:
The robot is next to the red ball, facing it, and I've called rest. The robot is now crouched with its motors off.

In the last camera image the ball is on the floor a short distance ahead, slightly right of center. The ball wasn't in front of the robot at the start, so I walked around the room and scanned until I saw it. I then turned toward it and walked up close. Rest made the robot turn slightly (heading 1.68 to 1.51 rad), so it may sit a little off-center from the ball.
